exposure: history of chronic diseases (hypertension, thyroid disease, cardiovascular disorders, diabetes mellitus)
previous surgery in the genital tract
cohort: The study included a convenient sample of 290 pregnant women attending antenatal care units in Babylon governorate.
finding: The study identified anemia (18.6%), hypertension (6.9%), Rh-negative sensitization (6.2%) as common current pregnancy risk factors, and multiparity (8.3%), previous miscarriage (12.1%), and previous CS (16.2%) as past pregnancy risk factors for high-risk pregnancy.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section (CS) was identified as a risk factor, affecting 16.2% of past pregnancies in the cohort.
